technical.summary: WEC shows solid structural bullish alignment (price above all MAs, golden cross, SAR bullish) but lacks momentum confirmation (weak ADX, negative MACD, low stochastic) and no triggered strategies, making this a moderate-quality entry suitable for patient accumulation rather than aggressive swing trading.

fundamental.summary: WEC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 55 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and dated (most recent 105 days ago), with only small-value sales from non-senior members providing no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (297) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals; earnings in 55 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Structural bullish alignment (EMA golden cross, price above all major MAs, SAR bullish, OBV rising) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 297) offers asymmetric risk/reward for patient accumulation near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, strong dollar), zero momentum confirmation (ADX 14.74, MACD negative, RSI 47, stoch 27), no fundamental conviction (earnings risk in 55 days, no insider/institutional buying), and no triggered strategies make this a low-probability swing trade entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Structural bullish alignment (golden cross, price above all MAs) combined with extreme fear-zone contrarian signal offers asymmetric setup, but zero momentum confirmation and severe macro headwinds make this unsuitable for immediate swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and crisis VIX (297) signal recession risk; earnings event in 55 days adds uncertainty; negative MACD and weak ADX (14.74) indicate momentum failure despite technical structure.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see opportunity; fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate correctly identifies bear case as winner.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 62 Utilities positions and existing WEC position; sector concentration and earnings proximity warrant reduced sizing if entry occurs; current 0% drawdown allows flexibility but macro environment argues for patience.
